C1.abstain_fallback: If OBD misfire/cooling/compression evidence is not supplied, keep the case abstained rather than using HC alone.
C1.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD Mode $06/freeze-frame; Tier (b) existing 5-gas for coolant headspace/two-point tailpipe; Tier (c) compression/leak-down/current clamp
C1.maneuver: Cold-start OBD misfire capture; warm coolant headspace sniff; cranking compression/leak-down; idle then 2500 rpm 5-gas hold.
C1.measurement: Mode $06 per-cylinder misfire/freeze-frame + cooling headspace HC/block test + compression/leak-down or relative compression + two-point HC/O2 behavior
C1.producer_threshold: Emit COOLANT_INTRUSION, COMPRESSION_LOSS, OIL_BURNING_PATTERN, or IGNITION_MISFIRE_CORROBORATED from the combined evidence.
C1.range_or_enum: coolant breach: headspace HC >50 ppm; mechanical loss: compression <90 psi or relative <85%; ignition misfire: elevated O2 around 5% with normal compression; valve-seal plume uses sustained two-point HC, not snap folklore
C1.separates: mechanical_wear from ignition/misfire and coolant-intrusion lookalikes
C1.title: C1 — mechanical wear vs misfire vs coolant intrusion

C2.abstain_fallback: If Mode $06 catalyst data and fuel trims are absent, leave the case abstained; a single downstream tailpipe snapshot is not a discriminator.
C2.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD Mode $01/$06 first; Tier (b) existing 5-gas used as dual-point/dual-probe corroboration
C2.maneuver: Warm closed-loop; hold 2500±100 rpm for 120 s; collect idle trims; read Mode $06 catalyst monitor; if available compare pre/post catalyst gas or upstream/downstream O2 during lean/rich perturbation.
C2.measurement: Mode $06 catalyst monitor + fuel trims; optional pre/post-cat or upstream/downstream O2/5-gas conversion check
C2.producer_threshold: Rich producer emits TRUE_RICH when negative trims are sustained; catalyst producer emits LOW_OSC_OR_HIGH_INDEX when Mode $06 margin/index fails without rich trims.
C2.range_or_enum: margin >= 10% pass-band; index_ratio <= 0.20 pass / high ratio fail; total trim near 0 for catalyst, <= -10% for true rich; nullable if tool unsupported
C2.separates: rich_mixture from catalyst_failure, and C2 catalyst-vs-lean/rich runner-ups
C2.title: C2 — rich mixture vs catalyst failure

C3.abstain_fallback: If no KOEO plausibility or voltage/divergence data are supplied, keep control-dispersion cases abstained.
C3.consumer_rule: labs/comlab/registry/rules/ecu_fault.json EF-001/EF-002/EF-003 and sensor_fault.json SF-001/SF-002 when dispersion presents as sensor bias
C3.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD live data for MAP/BARO/trims/voltage; Tier (b) 5-gas for physical lambda; Tier (c) DMM/breakout/bidirectional scan tool
C3.maneuver: KOEO pressure/voltage gate; high electrical load ground test; warm closed-loop 5-gas+OBD capture; optional +25%/-12.5% fuel command response.
C3.measurement: KOEO MAP-vs-BARO plausibility, module supply/ground voltage under load, gas-vs-OBD lambda divergence, bidirectional response
C3.producer_threshold: Emit CONTROL_REFERENCE_FAULT when electrical/reference or gas-vs-OBD divergence gates pass.
C3.range_or_enum: MAP-BARO delta >=5 kPa, ground drop >0.20 V, ground joint >0.10 V, lambda divergence >=0.05, trims railed ±25%, active response absent/reversed
C3.separates: ecu_fault/control dispersion from true lean/rich/sensor/catalyst chemistry
C3.title: C3 — ECU/control-system fault
C3.units: kPa, V, V, lambda, lambda, bool

C5.abstain_fallback: If only one warm-idle trim/gas point is available, leave the case abstained.
C5.consumer_rule: labs/comlab/registry/rules/lean_condition.json LC-001/LC-002/LC-003 plus exhaust_leak.json EL-001 when C4 consumes the shared trim columns
C5.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD live PIDs where supported; Tier (c) fuel-pressure gauge/transducer where rail pressure PID absent
C5.maneuver: Warm closed-loop; 60 s idle; 30 s 2500±100 rpm no-load; safe WOT/load sweep where available; sample >=10 Hz.
C5.measurement: STFT/LTFT across idle, 2500 rpm, and load/WOT; calculated load/MAF and fuel pressure under load
C5.producer_threshold: Emit VACUUM_LEAK_TRIM_PATTERN, FUEL_DELIVERY_SHORTFALL, or MAF_UNDERREAD based on multi-point trim/load/pressure signature.
C5.range_or_enum: vacuum leak: trim positive at idle then recovers at 2500; fuel delivery: lean worsens under load with pressure drop >35 kPa; MAF under-read: peak load <80% with positive trims
C5.separates: lean_condition sub-causes and shared C4 exhaust-leak/true-lean collisions
C5.title: C5 — lean-condition root cause

C6.abstain_fallback: If only static O2/MAF values are supplied, keep the case abstained.
C6.consumer_rule: labs/comlab/registry/rules/sensor_fault.json SF-005/SF-008/SF-001/SF-002 and no_fault.json NF-001/NF-002 for healthy-vs-under-detected split
C6.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD Mode $06/live PIDs when decisive; Tier (c) scope for millisecond response or missing scan-tool dynamics
C6.maneuver: Warm closed-loop; read Mode $06; if absent/equivocal, hold ~2500 rpm then decel fuel cut and controlled return; capture MAF/MAP/IAT/BARO/RPM at idle and 2500.
C6.measurement: Mode $06 O2-sensor dynamics with rich↔lean response fallback; MAF actual-vs-calculated airflow plausibility
C6.range_or_enum: use vehicle Mode $06 limits; O2 slower than OEM limit is fault; MAF sustained >10-15% low vs modeled airflow at both points is provisional fault
C6.separates: sensor_fault from no_fault, misfire, lean, and catalyst lookalikes
C6.title: C6 — sensor fault under-detection
C6.units: %, ms, ms, %, %, g/s, g/s, g/s, g/s

C7.abstain_fallback: If cam/VVT or VE evidence is unavailable, keep cam-timing residuals abstained.
C7.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD live data/DTC/freeze-frame when supported; Tier (c) scope/OEM tool for cam correlation if generic PIDs unavailable
C7.maneuver: Warm engine; baseline idle; WOT or loaded sweep; 2500±50 rpm at 50-70% calculated load for 30 s; sample >=10 Hz.
C7.measurement: VVT command-vs-actual angle, cam-to-crank correlation, VE/MAF-at-RPM signature
C7.range_or_enum: tracking error beyond OEM tolerance; cam-crank correlation fault/P0016-class; depressed VE/MAF at 2500 load compared with expected displacement/RPM model
C7.separates: cam_timing/VVT from misfire, sensor, and chemically non-normal exhaust
C7.title: C7 — cam timing / VVT fault

C8.abstain_fallback: If cranking data are absent, keep no-start rows abstained; warm-idle gas cannot exist for these cases.
C8.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD RPM/DTC/freeze-frame where supported; Tier (c) vacuum gauge, fuel-pressure gauge, spark tester, noid light/scope, current clamp
C8.maneuver: No-start crank test; 10-15 s maximum crank with 2 min cooldown; collect OBD while cranking plus shop measurements.
C8.measurement: Cranking evidence bundle: RPM, relative compression, cranking vacuum, fuel pressure, injector pulse, spark, immobilizer/security status
C8.producer_threshold: Emit the no-start substate indicated by the first positive cranking discriminator.
C8.range_or_enum: rpm=0 -> CKP path; vacuum <3 inHg or relative compression <85% -> compression; low pressure -> fuel; pulse 0 -> ECU/immobilizer; no spark -> ignition
C8.separates: non_starter root causes from invalid ambient-air exhaust samples and misfire-like no-starts
C8.title: C8 — non-starter root cause
C8.units: rpm, inHg, kPa, kPa, ms, bool, bool, %

C9.abstain_fallback: If any OBD health evidence is unsupported, incomplete, marginal, contradictory, or freshly reset, leave the case abstained.
C9.feasibility: Tier (a) OBD Mode $01/$03/$07/$06 plus Mode $0A/Service $09 when supported; Tier (b) two-point 5-gas corroboration
C9.maneuver: Warm closed-loop; read OBD status before any clear; capture stable idle and 2500 rpm no-load trim/gas windows.
C9.measurement: OBD health-confirmation bundle: readiness complete, no stored/pending/permanent DTCs, Mode $06 margins, trim stability, two-point gas stability
C9.producer_threshold: Emit HEALTH_CONFIRMED only when OBD bundle is complete and non-marginal; otherwise emit HEALTH_UNPROVEN_ABSTAIN.
C9.range_or_enum: all readiness complete; DTC counts 0; Mode $06 margin >= 10%; warmups>=15 and miles>=200 when available; trims near zero; gas stable
C9.research_source: cluster9.1.md §Bottom Line/Decision Rule and cluster9.2.md §Recommended decision rule
C9.separates: no_fault from catalyst-masked, sensor-under-detected, ECU/control, and intermittent pending faults
C9.title: C9 — confirm no fault reliably
C9.units: bool, count, count, count, %, cycles, miles, %, %, %, %, ppm, %, %, %

shared_c4_contract: C4 is not a new-column ask; its residuals consume the shared C5 trim/load columns and C6 O2/MAF dynamics columns.
